name: siglus_rs
description: siglus_rs is an unofficial Rust implementation and multi-platform port of SiglusEngine, AVG32, UK2, and RealLive.
long_description: The app launchers (macOS bundle, iOS, Android, WebAssembly) import one game or many games at once, detect the engine (SiglusEngine, RealLive, AVG32, UK2), show cover art or the game icon, and let you pick the text encoding for non-Siglus games. See crates/game_launcher.
